message.content: The Battle of Waterloo, fought on 18 June 1815, resulted in roughly **23,000–25,000 total casualties** (killed, wounded, missing) across all sides. Allied forces (British, Dutch, Belgian, Prussian) suffered about 23,000 casualties, while the French incurred around 25,000. These figures are estimates based on contemporary reports and modern historical analyses.
